overview: A one-page State Department cross-reference sheet directs the reader to file 195/1688 for Despatch No. 42 from Stephan at Nagoya, dated January 4, 1936. The despatch transmitted Addendum No. 3 to Joint Freight Tariff No. 11, containing corrections and changes issued in connection with the Trans-Pacific Freight Conference of Japan and the Japan–Atlantic Coast Freight Conference.

people.name: Stephan
people.role: Sender of Despatch No. 42 from Nagoya

subfiles.title: Cross-reference sheet for Despatch No. 42 on Joint Freight Tariff No. 11
subfiles.about: The sheet refers researchers to another file containing a despatch that transmitted an amendment to a joint shipping freight tariff.
subfiles.summary: This filing sheet directs the reader to file 195/1688 for Despatch No. 42 from Stephan at Nagoya. The despatch transmitted Addendum No. 3, page 1, embodying corrections and changes to Joint Freight Tariff No. 11. The tariff involved the Trans-Pacific Freight Conference of Japan and the Japan–Atlantic Coast Freight Conference.

interest: The sheet is useful chiefly as a provenance and filing aid: it shows that documentation concerning Japanese international shipping rates was cross-filed elsewhere in the State Department decimal system. It identifies the precise despatch, date, originating post, tariff, and shipping conferences, allowing a historian to locate the substantive addendum and trace changes in trans-Pacific and Japan–Atlantic Coast freight arrangements.
